title.narrative: Reforming WHO´s work in hum. emergencies 2013-14

description.narrative: Capacity strengthening support to WHO's reform process to strengthen the organization in response to humanitarian crisis.
Kapacitetsstärkande stöd till WHOs reformprocess att stärka sitt humanitära responsarbete inkl. 1a året av dess implementering.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Specifically, this project has allowed WHO to: Institutionalise new policies, systems, procedures and approaches for its work in emergency risk management and humanitarian response. Develop and implement evidence-based policies and technical guidance relevant to stakeholders in both emergency risk management and humanitarian response. Play a leadership role in key inter-agency bodies including the Global Health Cluster, the IASC and the ISDR. Improve the collection and presentation of country health information for decision-making. Build its readiness capacity at all levels of the Organisation, and particularly at headquarters (HQ), to mobilizer rapid deployments during emergency response Contribute to the incidence decline of Ebola cases, enabling the response to evolve from a crisis-management operation geared toward the rapid scale-up of core capacities, to an agile more geographically targeted approach.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
